research_question: On consumed V56 holdout evidence, can replacing V48's second surface-text authorization pass with a compiler that consumes frozen V56 state provenance and typed event relations eliminate all four remaining call failures without changing any commitment or regressing a previously correct call?
project_effect: This isolates the boundary between understanding an action request and compiling a safe VRM action plan. It does not make the language model larger, alter V56 commitment semantics, change memory or personality, modify right-brain wording, integrate runtime code, or actuate a VRM model.
cognitive_rationale: A human does not decide that 'do not move' is forbidden after already understanding it as a positive request to remain still. Perception should determine event meaning once; action compilation should preserve that meaning, verify its provenance and grounding, order compatible steps, and fail closed when authorization is missing.
evidence_boundary: This is a development repair on the already consumed V56 holdout. It may reject V57 or authorize a new independent compiler holdout, but cannot provide fresh generalization evidence, runtime readiness, whole-right-brain quality, or broad human likeness.
tested_variable: Replace only V48 call authorization and conflict handling with the V57 relation-authorized compiler. Reuse frozen V56 commitments, state provenance, event maps, model fallback output, candidate grounding, ontology, dataset, and scorer.

required_for_every_call: frame evidence exactly occurs in the input
the requested target has an allowlisted action mapping
an exact grounded target anchor overlaps the frame evidence
authorization provenance identifies why this event is executable
authorization_contract.positive_idle_rule: A requested motion.idle event with local_directive or shared_directive provenance remains authorized even when its Japanese surface form contains lexical negation such as 動かないで or 動かずに.
authorization_contract.same_domain_sequence_rule: Multiple requested values in one domain are allowed only when each event is independently authorized and their order is recoverable from grounded mention order. The compiler must emit an ordered execution plan instead of treating all same-domain values as an unconditional conflict.
authorization_contract.legacy_coordination_bridge: A frozen explicit_request_force result without a V56 directive edge may remain authorized only when its own focus clause is non-finite coordination governed by a later request clause in the same sentence. A finite past or descriptive focus clause is not authorized by a later unrelated request.
authorization_contract.unresolved_model_request_policy: A model-only requested fallback without deterministic directive provenance cannot actuate and must fail closed until a separate selective-authorization experiment validates it.

prespecified_failure_repairs.expected_change: Compile left then right gaze instead of suppressing both as a domain conflict.
Compile motion.idle from semantic directive authorization.
Compile motion.idle from semantic directive authorization.
Block the earlier descriptive gaze event while preserving the later authorized happy expression.

prespecified_regression_guards.reason: Preserve a valid coordinated request whose grounded focus clause is governed by a later request clause even though V56 has no later grounded target node.
Cancelled earlier actions must remain blocked and requested replacement actions must remain executable.
Quoted or metalinguistic action strings must remain non-executable.
No new false action is allowed on exact external sentences.

decision_rule.pass: Only if every development gate passes. A pass authorizes construction of a new independent V57 compiler holdout, not runtime, shadow integration, or physical execution.
decision_rule.call_regression: Reject V57 immediately if any V48-correct call becomes wrong, even if aggregate accuracy improves.
decision_rule.partial_fix: Reject this V57 implementation if fewer than all four prespecified call failures are fixed; diagnose the remaining structural class without sentence-specific patches.
decision_rule.other_failure: Reject V57 under this preregistration and preserve V56 state semantics and the frozen V48 control.
